quotes.author: Linda S
quotes.text: Wildlife viewing and a sunset was the perfect way to end the day in Salt Lake City! Cramon, our guide, was very knowledgeable and answered our questions about the Great Salt Lake as well as the Salt Lake City area and gave us a wonderful tour of Antelope Island. We saw buffalo, pronghorn, and a very cute burrowing owl, among other animals and birds. Watching the sunset was such a beautiful, peaceful experience. Highly recommend! Linda S 9/14/2025 (opens in a new tab)

quotes.author: Austin D
quotes.text: The journey to the mountain top! This tour was amazing! Clayton was on point and very dynamic and intuitive toward our experience. The hike up the Buffalo Peak was an exhilarating experience. It brought complexion and color to the old saying, 'I've done been to the mountain top"....Definitely a must do in one's life time. Thank you Clayton. Austin D 8/05/2025 (opens in a new tab)

quotes.author: ddbenedict
quotes.text: Lovely tour and lovely ending Sara was a great guide and gave us lots of time with the animals. The hike at the end and sunset was phenomenal but a caution on the hike: it was a little more rugged and steep than described but there's a good place to stop midway to watch so it's all good. Definitely a fun experience! ddbenedict 6/06/2026 (opens in a new tab)

quotes.author: Denise S
quotes.text: Was a longer than expected bus ride that was a bit cramped. But it was well worth it. Guide found animals that we woun’t The views were beautiful, lots of wildlife, and the sunset was just amazing! Our guide was very knowledgeable, and I appreciated that he allowed us to have input on how long we stayed at each stop. Denise S 9/22/2025 (opens in a new tab)

quotes.author: Angela T
quotes.text: Sunset & Strawberry Moon The evening excursion to Antelope Island was a great way to end our trip to Salt Lake City. Our tour guide was very knowledgeable and personable. The evening sunset was breathtaking with a bonus view of the full strawberry moon. I would highly recommend this tour company and guide, Garth. Angela T 7/01/2026 (opens in a new tab)

quotes.author: vanessa v
quotes.text: Fun time! Such a fun crowd!! We had a blast and Sarah was AMAZING!!! Saw all the sites and more . Buffalo , birds, owls, antelope, and a beautiful sunset . Thank you for being Awesome Sarah 😊 vanessa v 8/26/2025 (opens in a new tab)
